exclusions: No teammate repository, model source, server response exports, or credentials collected.
All image/video/audio files and model weights excluded, including previously approved public home media.
Raw human responses, private comparison galleries, reviewer packages and machine-bound session records excluded.
Training arrays, raw Statcast/feed/video stores and operational runtime artifacts inventoried separately, not copied.
Entire research runtime/lock, Sites deployment checkout and media-dependent site checks require the full source repository and named external artifacts.
This subset is for internal review and portable contract checks, not a license grant or complete service.
